description: Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand says one of the 30 Canadian citizens and permanent residents missing after catastrophic flooding in Nepal's border region with China has been found safe.
title: Canadian missing after Nepal flooding found safe, Anand says

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The cast of Season 35 of Dancing With The Stars was officially announced on Wednesday, with a fresh lineup of familiar faces trading their famous day jobs for sequins, choreography and a shot at the mirror-ball trophy.
title: Dancing With The Stars announces Season 35 cast: Julia Stiles, Jenna Dewan and more to hit the ballroom floor

author: Andrew Kurjata
description: One of the teachers caught in the deadly school shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary has shared her story publicly for the first time, alongside a series of new lawsuits against OpenAI that allege the company should have warned Canadian officials about the shooter's ChatGPT activity.
title: 'My students should be here': Tumbler Ridge teacher shares toll of deadly school shooting

author: Sarah Petz
description: Flight attendants who work on Air Canada Express flights are voting on whether to authorize strike action as their union says bargaining talks have stalled.
title: Air Canada Express flight attendants vote on strike mandate as contract talks stall

author: Ashley Fitzpatrick
description: Dozens of people protested outside the RCMP detachment in Happy Valley-Goose Bay on Wednesday following the arrest of a man that was recorded and posted online by his girlfriend, who called the actions by the police officers excessive.
title: Complaints raised of excessive force by RCMP in Sheshatshiu Innu Nation as video circulates

author: Rachel Watts
description: A candidate for the Conservative Party of Quebec is apologizing for online comments he made at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic. He wrote that Quebecers in favour of vaccines should be euthanized. Just seven days into the election campaign, several other candidates in various parties have faced pushback and even calls to resign.
title: Candidate for Quebec Conservatives apologizes for 2020 post about euthanizing pro-vaccine people

description: The NBA has declined to suspend Kawhi Leonard or void his contract after its salary-cap circumvention investigation into the Los Angeles Clippers, clearing a major hurdle for his proposed return to the Toronto Raptors.
title: Kawhi Leonard avoids suspension in NBA's salary cap probe, clearing major hurdle for Toronto Raptors return

description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday implied the Bank of Canada was a commercial bank with locations south of the border, not a Crown corporation based up north.
title: Donald Trump mistakes Bank of Canada for retail bank

author: Lyndsay Armstrong, Eli Ridder
description: Hilroy has apologized for leaving Newfoundland and Cape Breton off the Canadian map on its glossy notebooks, after the mistake led to backlash online.
title: Hilroy says sorry for leaving Newfoundland, Cape Breton off notebooks' Canadian map

description: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial have said — for a second time — that they are unable to reach a verdict on whether she is criminally responsible in the killings of her three children, but the judge on Wednesday told them again to keep trying.
title: Jurors in trial of U.S. mother who killed her children again tell judge they are deadlocked

description: Donegal Wilson, MLA for Boundary-Similkameen, and Scott McInnis, MLA for Columbia River-Revelstoke, have have quit the B.C. Conservative caucus.
title: 2 more B.C. Conservative MLAs quit caucus to sit as Independents

author: Jorge Barrera
description: A Mexican court has issued arrest warrants against the man and woman accused of defrauding a Canadian couple of their retirement savings through an alleged condo-flip scheme, CBC News has learned.
title: Arrest warrants issued in Mexico for duo accused in alleged condo scam

description: South Africa's aviation regulator is probing a low flypast by two jets over a Cape Town stadium last week.
title: Low flypast over Cape Town stadium to be reviewed, South Africa says

description: Chevron will invest more than $7 billion US through its Venezuela joint ventures to double oil production to about 600,000 barrels per day over the next five years in the ‌South American country, the U.S. oil major said on Wednesday.
title: Chevron expands Venezuela presence with $7B US plan

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: In a lawsuit filed this week in California, Alanis Morissette is suing her former tour manager for what she calls a "calculated blackmail campaign," alleging Keren Urinov threatened to frame her for drug trafficking unless the Canadian singer-songwriter agreed to sign her to a lengthy contract.
title: Alanis Morissette sues former tour manager over alleged 'calculated blackmail campaign'

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: In a lawsuit filed this week in California, Alanis Morrisette is suing her former tour manager for what she calls a "calculated blackmail campaign," alleging Keren Urinov threatened to frame her for drug trafficking unless the Canadian singer-songwriter agreed to sign her to a lengthy contract.
title: Alanis Morrisette sues former tour manager over alleged 'calculated blackmail campaign'

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Grab your glitteriest outfit and your tallest blonde wig: Dollyfest is set to go ahead in 2027 without its titular star, with the festival now transformed into a celebration of Dolly Parton’s life, her estate has announced.
title: Get your rhinestones ready: Dollyfest 2027 set to honour Dolly Parton's legacy

author: Ozten Shebahkeget
description: A Winnipeg woman says she's still recovering, but glad everyone is safe, days after rescuing both a child who fell into the Red River and the girl's father, who attempted to save the child.
title: 'I don't feel like a hero,' says Winnipeg woman who saved father, drowning toddler from Red River

description: In a strategic retreat in the fight against climate change, the United Nations has acknowledged that Earth has lost its chance to prevent some of the worst of global warming's harms. Officials say the world must now figure out how to get temperatures below the danger zone and back to safety.
title: Climate change past the point of no return, UN says, as worst impacts are now unavoidable

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Netflix is promising viewers a more complete picture of the Canadian-raised actor in the three-part docuseries The One About Matthew Perry.
title: Matthew Perry documentary coming to Netflix in October

description: The rise of AI video-generation tools like Seedance is taking jobs away from actors in China’s short drama industry.
title: Fact check: Is Chinese AI replacing actors?

description: This decision marks the seventh consecutive hold by the central bank.
title: Bank of Canada holds key interest rate at 2.25%
Liberals will extend gas and diesel gas tax holiday into 2027, sources say

author: Matt Preprost
description: New legal filings describe the horror students and teachers experienced on Feb. 10 and include new details of OpenAI's alleged negligence in preventing the shooting.
title: Teachers, students file new wave of lawsuits against OpenAI over Tumbler Ridge shooting

author: Tara Deschamps
description: Under the partnership launched between the restaurant and the home goods company on Wednesday, customers who link their Triangle and Tims Rewards accounts will earn between two and five per cent in Canadian Tire money in addition to Tims points on select Tims purchases.
title: Canadian Tire and Tim Hortons join forces to link their loyalty programs

description: Tiger Woods entered a plea agreement on Wednesday to a reckless driving charge following a rollover crash in March near his home in Florida.
title: Tiger Woods enters plea agreement to reckless driving charge over Florida crash

author: Aishwarya Dudha
description: Students at Bethlehem Catholic High School will be back in class Wednesday for the first time since a fire last month — and the school day has been cut by half for most.
title: Students return to Saskatoon high school missing 26 classrooms after fire

author: Jason Proctor
description: B.C.'s consumer watchdog is locked in a court battle with Telus after accusing the telecommunications giant of stonewalling an inspector trying to determine if a mistaken $1,435.65 contract cancellation fee was part of a bigger issue.
title: Telus accused of misleading B.C. consumer watchdog in probe sparked by mistaken $1,400 cancellation fee

description: Iran and its Arab neighbours were plunged back into war on Wednesday by the biggest exchange of fire between Te
title: Tehran attacks U.S. bases across Gulf after reports of deadly strike on wedding

description: With Germany’s far right party ahead in the polls, voters in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt are gearing up for what could be one of the most significant elections in the country’s post-war history.
title: Is Germany's firewall against the far right crumbling?

author: Isha Bhargava
description: Riding on Prime Minister Mark Carney's use of the proper word for a body of water, a London, Ont., company has created T-shirts emblazoned with "My hydronyms are Lake and Ontario." A portion of the apparel sales proceeds go to Swim Drink Fish Canada, a charity that connects people with the lake, and works to keep it safe and clean.
title: Carney's 'hydronym' moment is behind a cheeky campaign to raise awareness about Lake Ontario

author: Colin North
description: A longtime women's clothing store called Rudolf's Ladies Wear is closing its door after more than 100 years of operation, with Jane Lordly, the current manager and owner, having worked it for 40 years. Lordly says she received an offer for the space she couldn't refuse.
title: Historic Lunenburg, N.S., women's clothing store that's seen everything from bloomers to bikinis is closing

description: Hopes of finding more survivors among the thousands still missing in Nepal were fading, authorities said on Wednesday, a week after a glacier collapse in the Himalayas unleashed flash floods that devastated the mountainous nation.
title: Hopes of finding survivors dim a week after catastrophic Nepal flood
Plane spotter or Chinese spy? Ontario university student suspected of espionage at airports

author: Ina Sidhu
description: Shoppers looking to save money on Lululemon apparel have another option. The athletic wear company has launched its resale site in Canada. A 25,000 square foot processing hub in Calgary is at the center of the expansion.
title: Lululemon the latest brand to bet on resale as second-hand clothing becomes big business

author: Sarah Law
description: Four weeks after Neskantaga First Nations declared a state of emergency over a sewage spill at its nursing station, a fire at the temporary health-care facility has left the community scrambling again. Officials with Indigenous Services Canada have visited the First Nation to assess the situation, which has forced the relocation of about 250 vulnerable people to Toronto.
title: Neskantaga First Nation's lack of health-care infrastructure forces evacuation of dozens to Toronto

author: Murray Brewster
description: It has been 20 years since Canadian soldiers walked into a Taliban killing ground west of Kandahar. Operation Medusa became Canada’s largest battle since Korea — a brutal test against a disciplined, entrenched enemy. Canada prevailed, but at a terrible cost, in a fight that changed the Afghan war and those who survived it.
title: The battle that made Canada bleed: Operation Medusa, 20 years later

author: Kyle Bakx
description: U.S President Donald Trump is continuing his pursuit of Venezuela's oil jackpot, announcing a new deal aimed at boosting production in the South American country. And while Trump is flaunting the potential controlling stake in a portion of Venezuela's oil reserves as a warning to Canada, experts say there is little cause for concern in Western Canada.
title: The U.S. could control 20% of Venezuela's oil reserves. Canada's oilpatch isn't worried
